text:
No fire was detected on this asset during the evaluated period (2026-09-23 to 2026-10-23). NASA FIRMS active-fire data showed zero detections whose footprint intersects the asset.

The result is reliable for the data used. All four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, VIIRS NOAA-20, VIIRS NOAA-21 and MODIS) covered every day of the period, which is the run's rule for counting a sensor as covered.

Some limits apply. FIRMS detects thermal anomalies from satellite overpasses, so very small, brief, or cloud-obscured fires could be missed. The data is near-real-time, so it may be revised later. The asset's area wasn't recorded in the run metadata (asset_area_ha is null), so I can't comment on how large the asset is relative to the detection pixels.

In short, no fire evidence was found for the period, but this is not an absolute guarantee that no fire occurred.
